build_layerconcat: build a LayerConcat module to apply multiple layers and concatenate their outputs along a specified dimension
build_tensorparallelhead: build a TensorParallelHead layer that gathers outputs across processes using all_gather for tensor-parallel LM heads
build_tensorparallelcolumnlinear: build a TensorParallelColumnLinear layer to load sharded column weights for QKV or gate-up projections
build_tensorparallelrowlinear: build a TensorParallelRowLinear layer that applies all_reduce across processes after a row-wise linear transformation
build_tensorparallelembedding: build a TensorParallelEmbedding layer that shards token embeddings across processes and reduces outputs with all_reduce
